purpose: Canonical per-platform canvas, render-master and safe-text-zone table for Nyx. Pure data: nothing here publishes, uploads or opens a platform. Loaded by render_masters.py (production overlay/output sizing) and visual_qa_benchmark.py (QA).
units: safe_text_zone insets are fractions of the canvas edge (0.10 on top of a 1920px canvas = keep text below y=192). Text must sit fully inside the inset rectangle.

confidence_legend.high: platform-published spec or behaviour stable for years
confidence_legend.medium: widely used creator convention measured from the live UI; UI chrome moves, re-verify quarterly
confidence_legend.low: no published spec; internal convention chosen to be conservative

public_carousel_4x5.role: THE public carousel master. Every public slide is authored, approved and QA'd at 4:5 first.

vertical_9x16.role: Separate vertical master, ONLY for TikTok and Fanvue. Never sent to Instagram, Threads or X.

feed_carousel.crop_behaviour: Carousel slides taller than 4:5 are centre-cropped to 4:5; a 9:16 slide loses ~14.8% at top AND bottom.

grid_preview_crop.note: profile grid centre-crops ~3.1% off each side

story.note: Meta guidance: keep ~250px top and bottom free of text/logos.

reel.note: Bottom 35% holds caption/audio/CTA; right rail holds like/comment/share.

video_or_photo_mode.note: Top: Following/For You tabs. Bottom: handle, caption, sound, nav bar. Right: action rail.

feed_image.note: UI chrome sits outside the image; taller-than-4:5 behaviour in multi-image rows unverified. Channel itself is UNVERIFIED.

timeline_single_image.crop_behaviour: Single images from 16:9 to ~3:4 render uncropped on mobile; taller images are centre-cropped to ~3:4 in the timeline and only shown whole on tap.
timeline_single_image.note: Channel is PREPARED_NOT_CONNECTED -- copy/assets may be prepared, never published.

feed_post.note: No published Fanvue canvas spec. 9:16 matches every Fanvue story lock. Locked/PPV previews blur the image with a centred lock+price badge, so the middle band carries no text on paid posts.
